newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Toepfer said to buy 75,000 tonnes Argentine wheat.
newsitem.headline: Toepfer said to buy 75,000 tonnes Argentine wheat.

text.p: German grain exporter Toepfer bought 75,000 tonnes Argentine wheat for January and February shipment on Friday, Argentine traders said Monday.
Toepfer's Hamburg office bought 20,000 tonnes for February and two shipments of 20,000 tonnes and 25,000 tonnes for January. The January deals were done at $141 FOB and February at $142 FOB.
Traders said they did not know what the destination was.
One trader said he thought sales of Argentine 1996/97 wheat totaled 2.4 million tonnes so far. An analyst last week said sales totaled between 2.5 million and 3.0 million tonnes.
With a bumper crop likely, Argentine wheat exports are expected to double this season to eight million to nine million tonnes.

"With our prices, Argentine wheat can go anywhere," a trader said. He added that they were receiving enquiries from non-traditional destinations including Bulgaria and Poland, but that he knew of no firm deals yet.
